name: PontaHR
description: Bring your PontaHR hiring data into Claude. Ask about your pipeline, candidates, and reports in plain language and get answers pulled straight from your live ATS — no exports, no tab-switching. Search job listings and applications with rich filters, open a candidate's full application and scorecards, review activity timelines, and pull overview, hiring, and productivity reports. Your existing PontaHR permissions are fully respected, so the assistant only ever sees what you can see.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PontaHR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PontaHR to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.pontahr.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PontaHR MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PontaHR lists 15 MCP tools, including search_candidates, search_job_applications, get_job_application, get_job_application_timeline, get_job_application_timelines, get_comment, get_email_message, get_scorecard, list_job_listings, get_job_listing, get_listing_funnel, and get_overview_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PontaHR?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PontaHR in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
PontaHR requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PontaHR is developed by PontaHR. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
